accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 text ratio). Pure white #FFFFFF and soft white #F4F4F6 against #090A0C yields 18.2:1 contrast. Metallic gold #D4AF37 against #090A0C yields 8.1:1 contrast.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, tabs, status dropdowns, modal triggers, export buttons) MUST contain descriptive kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab navigation through table rows, filter bars, quick-action sheets, and modal forms.

third_party_libraries_recommended: leaflet and @types/leaflet (or MapLibre/custom Canvas engine) for Kolkata live fleet interactive map pinning Park Street, Salt Lake Sector V, Howrah, Airport, New Town, Esplanade
recharts (already preinstalled in template) for Hourly Ride Volume, Revenue Split by Service, Driver Online vs Busy charts, Cancellation Root Causes
lucide-react (preinstalled) for clean geometric operational icons
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the matte black + metallic gold aesthetic strictly: Background #090A0C, panel #11141A, gold accent #D4AF37. Never use bright saturated tech blues or generic AI purples (#7351B7 is strictly forbidden).

Incorporate all Kolkata-specific operational context: 8 Service categories (Bike, Auto, Cab, Sedan, XL, Rentals, Outstation, Parcel) with Kolkata hub locations (Park Street, Salt Lake Sec V, Howrah Station, CCU Airport, New Town, Ballygunge, Esplanade, Jadavpur).

Implement the 11-stage ride lifecycle state machine with dedicated badge colors and drawer actions: draft, searching, driver_assigned, driver_arriving, waiting_at_pickup, otp_pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled, expired, disputed.

Seed high-quality, realistic Kolkata ride data: 3000 daily rides simulation, 40+ active driver profiles with KYC statuses (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Action Required), fare slabs for each service type, and realistic SOS incidents.
Build the Wallet Ledger screen with 3 distinct balance pools: User-Funded (Cash/UPI), Promotional Credits, and Cashback Balance, with an immutable double-entry style ledger table.
Ensure Fare Configuration allows setting Base Fare, Min Fare, Per KM, Per Minute, Waiting Charge, Cancellation Fee, Surge Multiplier ceiling, and Night Charge (11 PM - 5 AM).
Ensure Commission Configuration supports both percentage commission per category AND Zero-Commission Subscription Passes (Daily, Weekly, Monthly passes).
Include quick-login buttons on the login page for Instant Demo Access (Super Admin, Fleet Manager, Operations Lead) with pre-filled credentials.
Provide clear export capability (CSV / Excel download simulated) and robust filtering by date range, service category, driver, rider, status, and zone.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI Slop' — use deliberate, high-density layouts designed for 24/7 mission-critical ride-hailing dispatch operations.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors duration-150` or `transition-transform duration-100`.

Keep map interactions responsive and clear. In dark mode, style the map tiles with sleek dark cartography (e.g. CartoDB Dark Matter / Alidade Smooth Dark) so gold and green fleet markers stand out sharply.
Every badge, chip, and interactive row must have explicit text contrast against its own background container.
Use sonner for notifications (KYC approved, Fare saved, Pass created, SOS acknowledged, Ride cancelled/refunded).
